title: US stocks end higher after Supreme Court rules against Trump tariffs
title_zh: 最高法院裁定特朗普关税无效后美股收高
summary: STORY: Wall Street's main indexes ended higher on Friday, with the Dow adding nearly half a percent, the S&P 500 gaining about seven-tenths of a percent and the Nasdaq climbing nine-tenths of a percent.The U.S.
summary_zh: 故事：华尔街主要股指周五收高，道指上涨近半个百分点，标准普尔 500 指数上涨约十分之七，纳斯达克指数上涨十分之九。

title: Microsoft Names Sharma to Lead Xbox, Recommits to Console
title_zh: 微软任命 Sharma 领导 Xbox，重新致力于主机业务
summary: Spencer, who has run the Xbox business since 2014 and was named gaming CEO in 2022 is retiring, the company said.  Xbox games studios chief Matt Booty will become chief content officer, reporting to Sharma.
summary_zh: 该公司表示，自 2014 年以来一直负责 Xbox 业务并于 2022 年被任命为游戏首席执行官的斯宾塞即将退休。  Xbox 游戏工作室负责人 Matt Booty 将成为首席内容官，向 Sharma 汇报。

title: Reduced tariff threats should allow market volatility to subside
title_zh: 减少关税威胁应该可以平息市场波动
summary: US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) closed Friday's session in positive territory, managing to cap off the shortened trading week with slight gains after rallying in the day following the Supreme Court's (SCOTUS) decision to strike down President Trump's sweeping tariff policies.
summary_zh: 美国股市（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）周五收盘上涨，在最高法院 (SCOTUS) 决定推翻特朗普总统全面关税政策后的第二天上涨后，成功结束了缩短的交易周，并小幅上涨。

title: Earnings live: Nvidia earnings will offer crucial AI update, cap off 'Magnificent Seven' results
title_zh: 实时财报：英伟达财报将提供重要的人工智能更新，为“七雄”业绩画上圆满句号
summary: The S&P 500 was on track for double-digit earnings growth, with more than half of companies having reported Q4 results so far.
summary_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数有望实现两位数的盈利增长，迄今为止已有超过一半的公司公布了第四季度业绩。

title: Nike, Big Tech, furniture stocks reacting to SCOTUS tariff ruling
title_zh: 耐克、大型科技公司、家具股对最高法院关税裁决做出反应
summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre and Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma join Market Domination Host Josh Lipton in tracking several of the day's top trending stock tickers after US Supreme Court officials struck down President Trump's trade tariffs on Friday, inc...
summary_zh: 雅虎财经市场和数据编辑贾里德·布利克尔（Jared Blikre）和高级记者布鲁克·迪帕尔玛（Brooke DiPalma）与《市场支配》主持人乔什·利普顿（Josh Lipton）一起追踪当日美国最高法院官员推翻特朗普总统的贸易关税后几只热门股票行情，包括...

title: US stocks, gold rally after SCOTUS strikes down Trump tariffs
title_zh: 联邦最高法院否决特朗普关税后，美国股市和黄金上涨
summary: US Supreme Court justices (SCOTUS) have ruled to strike down President Trump's sweeping tariff policies that he implemented under IEEPA (International Emergency Economic Powers Act).
summary_zh: 美国最高法院法官 (SCOTUS) 裁定废除特朗普总统根据 IEEPA（国际紧急经济权力法案）实施的全面关税政策。

title: Expect a 'cyclical upswing' as US stocks finds footing in 2026
title_zh: 美股2026年站稳脚跟，预计将出现“周期性上涨”
summary: US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) are lagging behind global markets so far in 2026 year-to-date, signaling the worst start to a new trading year since 1995.
summary_zh: 2026 年迄今，美国股市（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）落后于全球市场，标志着自 1995 年以来新交易年最糟糕的开局。

title: Nvidia is moving in on Intel and AMD's home turf
title_zh: Nvidia 正在进军英特尔和 AMD 的主场
summary: Nvidia is getting into the CPU server market, and that could be trouble for Intel and AMD.
summary_zh: Nvidia 正在进军 CPU 服务器市场，这可能会给英特尔和 AMD 带来麻烦。
